route_title: 22-Layer ZnS/MgF2 with Bounded Quasi-Periodic Initialization and Two-Phase Optimizer
compilation_rationale: Bounded route expands the override to exactly 12 finite ZnS/MgF2 layers on CaF2 per compiler policy. Two-phase pairing/decoupling is abstracted into a single continuous thickness gradient sweep initialized near 1050 nm (~lambda/2 effective optical thickness at design) with explicit [750, 1250] nm bounds. All four spectral bands are independently scored via mean-transmittance objectives. Coherent smatrix solver handles dispersion-resolved R/T/A across 2500–5000 nm under normal unpolarized illumination. Numeric targets replace prior nulls to resolve type-casting errors.
